Get and set the slots of a qseaSet

Source: R/qseaSlots.R
qseaSlots.Rd

Read and replace the contents of a qseaSet. qsea exports accessors for most slots, but none for libraries or enrichment, and no replacement functions at all. These generics fill those gaps, so that code never has to reach into a slot with @.

getLibraries(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'qseaSet'
getLibraries(object, type = NULL)

setLibraries(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'qseaSet'
setLibraries(object, value, type = NULL)

getEnrichment(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'qseaSet'
getEnrichment(object, name = NULL)

setEnrichment(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'qseaSet'
setEnrichment(object, value, name = NULL)

setCounts(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'qseaSet'
setCounts(object, value)

setRegions(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'qseaSet'
setRegions(object, value)

setSampleTable(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'qseaSet'
setSampleTable(object, value)

setParameters(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'qseaSet'
setParameters(object, values)

setCNV(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'qseaSet'
setCNV(object, value)

Arguments

object

qseaSet The object to query or modify.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods. Not used by the qseaSet methods.

type

character(1) or NULL Which library table to return or replace: "file_name" for the pulldown libraries, "input_file" for the input libraries. NULL returns the whole list. Default: NULL.

value

The replacement value: a matrix for setCounts(), a GRanges for setRegions() and setCNV(), a data.frame for setSampleTable(), and a data.frame/matrix (or a list when type/name is NULL) for setLibraries() and setEnrichment().

name

character(1) or NULL Which element of the enrichment slot to return or replace, such as "parameters", "factors", "pattern_name", "density" or "n". NULL returns or replaces the whole list. Default: NULL.

values

list Named list of parameters to merge into the parameters slot. Entries with an existing name are overwritten, the rest are left alone.

Value

  • getLibraries(): the libraries slot, a named list, or the single table named by type. Returns NULL when the set has no such table.

  • getEnrichment(): the enrichment slot, a named list, or the single element named by name. Returns NULL when absent.

  • setCounts(), setRegions(), setSampleTable(), setParameters(), setLibraries(), setEnrichment() and setCNV(): the updated qseaSet.

Details

The setters replace a slot without checking it against the rest of the object, so a sequence of calls can leave a qseaSet temporarily inconsistent (different numbers of samples in the count matrix and the sample table, say). Replace every affected slot before using the result.

Zygosity has no setter here because qsea already exports one, qsea::setZygosity().

See also

qsea::getCounts(), qsea::getRegions(), qsea::getSampleTable(), qsea::getParameters(), qsea::getCNV(), qsea::getZygosity(), qsea::setZygosity(), subsetQset()

Examples

data(exampleTumourNormal, package = "mesa")

# The pulldown library table, and the whole libraries slot
head(getLibraries(exampleTumourNormal, "file_name"))

names(getLibraries(exampleTumourNormal))
#> [1] "file_name"  "input_file"

# The fitted enrichment parameters
head(getEnrichment(exampleTumourNormal, "parameters"))
#>          a        b        c
#> Colon1_N 3 38.94236 3.691682
#> Colon1_T 3 33.24228 3.664828
#> Colon2_N 3 39.08955 3.691246
#> Colon2_T 3 48.25952 3.743099
#> Lung1_N  3 32.55499 3.743398
#> Lung1_T  3 26.14876 3.719395

# Replacing a slot returns a new qseaSet
sampleTable <- qsea::getSampleTable(exampleTumourNormal)
sampleTable$batch <- "A"
qs <- setSampleTable(exampleTumourNormal, sampleTable)
head(qsea::getSampleTable(qs))
#>          sample_name    group patient        type tumour tissue age gender
#> Colon1_N    Colon1_N Colon1_N  Colon1 NormalColon Normal  Colon  80      F
#> Colon1_T    Colon1_T Colon1_T  Colon1         CRC Tumour  Colon  80      F
#> Colon2_N    Colon2_N Colon2_N  Colon2 NormalColon Normal  Colon  67      F
#> Colon2_T    Colon2_T Colon2_T  Colon2         CRC Tumour  Colon  67      F
#> Lung1_N      Lung1_N  Lung1_N   Lung1  NormalLung Normal   Lung  64      F
#> Lung1_T      Lung1_T  Lung1_T   Lung1        LUAD Tumour   Lung  64      F
#>          stage batch
#> Colon1_N  <NA>     A
#> Colon1_T   III     A
#> Colon2_N  <NA>     A
#> Colon2_T    IV     A
#> Lung1_N   <NA>     A
#> Lung1_T    IIA     A

# Parameters are merged, not replaced wholesale
qs <- setParameters(exampleTumourNormal, list(minMapQual = 10))
qsea::getParameters(qs)$minMapQual
#> [1] 10
